name: Sign in and create a thesis workspace
description: Verifies a signed-in researcher can create a workspace and see its saved thesis settings.
steps: Sign in using the sign-in button
Create a workspace with a title and institution
expected: The workspace title and generated join code appear in the dashboard.

name: Edit and retain thesis proposal sections
description: Verifies editing a proposal section persists after navigating away and returning.
steps: Save changes and navigate to the dashboard
expected: The saved introduction text is still present.

name: Create, assign, and complete a task
description: Verifies a member can create a task, assign it, update status, and retain the changes.
steps: Create a task with a title and due date
Assign it to a workspace member and set status to In progress
expected: The task appears with the chosen assignee, due date, and status.

name: Prevent empty document and task submissions
description: Verifies required fields prevent empty records and forms remain usable on mobile.
steps: Leave the task title blank and submit
Open the document editor and save an empty section title
expected: Validation messages appear and no blank task or section is created.

name: Join a workspace as a second member
description: Verifies a second signed-in member can join using a workspace code and view shared tasks and document sections.
steps: Actor A creates a workspace and a task
Actor B signs in and enters Actor A's join code
Actor B opens the workspace tasks and document
expected: Actor B sees the shared workspace content; an invalid join code is rejected.
